units.source_text: “嗯，是五目……”名人喃喃地说罢，抬起浮肿的眼睑，也不想再清点，就确认了胜负棋子。

en.t: "Mm, it is five points..." the Master murmured. Then he raised his swollen eyelids and, without any wish to count again, accepted the stones that decided the game.

units.source_text: 终盘是下午二时四十二分。

en.t: The game ended at 2:42 in the afternoon.
